name: Memory Vault
runtime_test_scope: Four checks passed using the extracted alpha.0.29 client: registered replica recovery through ordinary receive, original delivery and restart recall, pending-receipt fairness, and replica-memory reception followed by independent receipt return. The exact-source cloud regression passed 1177 tests across 126 modules in two exhaustive partitions, with all 286 reported source hashes matching 20b53a5d664b622c01ffe209c65557ea2a1d2d04. Supported Python 3.10 and cross-platform conformance passed, and all eight public assets were downloaded through the authenticated GitHub client and matched. These results do not establish independent external adoption, global reliability or thousand-agent capacity.
discovery_scope: repository document, not an active service endpoint or a vendor directory registration

open_network.ack_directory_publication_scope: one independently consented directory and the original source; usable requires a separate authorized original receipt read
open_network.independent_receipt_repair_scope: explicit original signed receipt recovery through a separately authorized ACK source; no automatic relocation
open_network.ack_source_provisioning_scope: Explicit approved selection; independent remote setup uses only sender config plus selected source origin/key and explicit finite source opt-in; original live unbound custody precedes ciphertext; local operator mode remains available
open_network.contact_directory_maintenance_scope: Python and native Node recipients explicitly authorize a selected supporting Python node to renew unchanged public contact registration within original permissions and finite work. Exact enrollment and used work survive lost replies, restart and language switching; native Node hosts do not run the directory worker.
open_network.remote_ack_source_provisioning_scope: explicit finite Python source opt-in; sender uses only own config and selected public origin/key, with live unbound recovery before ciphertext and durable exact-request retry
open_network.mailbox_authorization_scope: Receiver-local approved contact and registered mailbox; durable exact destination/status originals and bounded paged export; explicit owner status revision coordination; no fresh remote permission claim.
open_network.bound_empty_replica_scope: Python explicit selected replacement, exact durable reservation and upload, independent return consents and owner recovery after original-source loss; COPY/READ/RETAIN only, no receipt admission or automatic selection.
open_network.occupied_replica_scope: Python explicit replica reservation/upload/configuration and original-send receipt recovery after source loss; independent recipient reservation/copy/return consent, exact receipt and history, durable retry and status observations. New receipt-index preparation can explicitly select copy_maintainer. No new receipt admission or automatic replacement.
open_network.mailbox_replica_scope: Python explicit separately reserved and independently consented directory, complete feed-prefix and encrypted-message copies; protected original-key reception through the durable inbox after source loss; retained revocations and restart/retry state; independent receipt return using original ACK authority. Automatic target selection, permission exchange and full native mailbox clients are unfinished.
